title: Can resize panel applets in invalid directions with win+rmb
line: Meta+right-dragging an applet popup now only resizes it from the same edges its own resize handles allow, so it can't be pulled over its panel or off the screen edge.
explanation: KWin's Meta+right-drag and its Resize Window shortcut pick the edges to move only from the pointer position. Applet popups are placed against their panel (and sometimes a screen edge), and libplasma's own resize handles leave those edges out, but KWin had no way to know which edges they were, so dragging near the panel grew the popup over it. The plasma-shell protocol gets a set_resizable_edges request: libplasma's AppletPopup sends the same edges its own resize handles use, and KWin leaves the other edges out of compositor-driven resizes (nothing is resized if no allowed edge is under the pointer).

commits.message:
plasma-shell: add set_resizable_edges

Applet popups can only be resized from the edges away from their panel
or screen edge, but the compositor had no way to know which ones. This
new request lets the client tell it which edges it may move.

BUG: 507821

window: honor the resizable edges of plasma surfaces

Meta+right-drag and the resize shortcut picked the edges to move only
from the pointer position, so an applet popup could be pulled over its
panel. They now skip the edges the surface doesn't allow to be resized.

BUG: 507821

AppletPopup: tell the compositor which edges can be resized

Meta+right-drag in KWin could resize an applet popup from the edges
facing its panel or the screen edge, which its own resize handles leave
out. The popup now sends the same edges to the compositor on Wayland.

BUG: 507821

patches.diff:
From 1961fe1fc47bcbb5962b5a54629481d258aac6a3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 02:55:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasma-shell: add set_resizable_edges

Applet popups can only be resized from the edges away from their panel
or screen edge, but the compositor had no way to know which ones. This
new request lets the client tell it which edges it may move.

BUG: 507821
---
 src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml | 25 +++++++++++++++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 23 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
index baca1af..3c3a87b 100644
--- a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
+++ b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
   ]]></copyright>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="9">
     <description summary="create shell windows and helpers">
       This interface is used by KF5 powered Wayland shells to communicate with
       the compositor and can only be bound one time.
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
     </request>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="9">
     <description summary="metadata interface">
       An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for
       implementations that provide the shell user interface.
@@ -304,5 +304,26 @@
         cursor position. Has to be called before attaching any buffer to this surface.
       </description>
     </request>
+
+    <enum name="edge" bitfield="true" since="9">
+      <entry name="top" value="1"/>
+      <entry name="bottom" value="2"/>
+      <entry name="left" value="4"/>
+      <entry name="right" value="8"/>
+    </enum>
+
+    <request name="set_resizable_edges" since="9">
+      <description summary="set the edges the compositor may resize">
+        Sets the edges of the surface that the compositor may move when the
+        user resizes the surface with a compositor action, for example by
+        dragging it with a modifier key held or with a keyboard shortcut. The
+        other edges stay where they are. This is meant for surfaces that are
+        placed against another surface or a screen edge, such as applet popups.
+
+        By default, all edges may be resized. Resizes started by the client
+        are not affected.
+      </description>
+      <arg name="edges" type="uint" enum="edge" summary="the edges that may be resized"/>
+    </request>
   </interface>
 </protocol>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Kickoff after Meta+right-dragging its bottom-left corner 100 px right and 50 px down: it now covers the panel and left its spot at the screen edge.
Same drag with the fix: nothing moves, because Kickoff's bottom edge (panel) and left edge (screen edge) aren't resizable, just like with its own handles.
Calendar popup after Meta+right-dragging its bottom-right corner down and right: it covers the right end of the panel and is pushed against the screen edge.
Same drag with the fix: the popup keeps its place above the panel and its gap to the screen edge.

review.text: Using an explicit `set_resizable_edges` request in `org_kde_plasma_surface` v9 sent by `AppletPopup` and enforced in KWin is the right architecture and cleanly prevents Meta+right-drag from pulling popups over panels or off screen edges. However, the resize shortcut / `PlasmaWindowInterface::resizeRequested` paths still unconditionally warp to `bottomRight()`, which causes keyboard/menu resize to fail completely on bottom-right popups like Digital Clock or System Tray, and there are multi-repo metadata and build-dependency details to fix before merging.
changes: In KWin (`src/window.cpp` `PlasmaWindowInterface::resizeRequested` and `Workspace::slotWindowResize` / window menu Resize), pick the warp corner/edge from `resizableEdges()` instead of always warping to `frameGeometry().bottomRight()`, so keyboard/menu resize works on bottom-right popups (where `resizableEdges()` is `TopEdge | LeftEdge`) and can resize both allowed axes on bottom-left popups like Kickoff.

Use `CCBUG: 507821` on the prerequisite commits (`plasma-wayland-protocols` and `kwin`) and keep `BUG: 507821` only on the final commit (`libplasma`), so merging the protocol change does not prematurely close the bug.

Bump the required `PlasmaWaylandProtocols` version in KWin's and libplasma's `CMakeLists.txt` (once released/tagged) or guard usage of the v9 protocol symbols so they do not fail to compile against older `plasma-wayland-protocols`.

In `libplasma`'s `PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration::setResizableEdges()`, mask `edges` with `Qt::TopEdge | Qt::BottomEdge | Qt::LeftEdge | Qt::RightEdge` so inverted `~nearbyBorders()` flags don't store set upper bits and trigger redundant protocol requests (and consider skipping `sendResizableEdges()` in `surfaceCreated()` when all edges are resizable).
